en: A vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a studio photograph of a woman in a shiny, loose-fitting costume posed in a modern dance position on the floor. She is barefoot, with one leg extended forward and the other bent, one hand resting on the extended leg and the other supporting her body. The background is plain. Centered below the photo is the name 'MARY WIGMAN'. Small printed credits appear in the lower left and right margins.
